transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Pain in both knees. It's getting worse.
When did you first notice the pain in your knees?
Been there for years, but much worse the last few months.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
No, not that I know of.
How much is the knee pain affecting your everyday activities these days?
It's affecting my daily activities. Hard to get around.
Could you tell me what medicines you take regularly, including any new or changed ones, and how much you take if you know?
I've taken anti-inflammatory medicines for the knees.
Have you ever had any operations, or been in hospital for anything?
No operations. My brother had knee surgery once, years back.
Would you say the knee pain is mild, moderate, or severe, or you’re not sure?
It's bad. Really bad some days.
Along with the knee pain, have you noticed anything else that's been different for you?
No, I haven't noticed anything else.
What kinds of things make your knee pain worse, if anything?
My wife used to do the gardening. Not anymore, with her back.
What worries you most about your knee pain, if anything?
Wondering if surgery could help. That's my main worry.
What seems to make your knee pain better or worse: moving around, sitting or lying down, something else, or are you not sure?
The medicines and injections only helped for a little while.
What does the pain in your knees feel like?
Just a bad pain. Nothing else to describe.
Is there anything else about your health history you'd like to add?
I worry about the risks. Infection, blood clots.
When your knee pain first started, did it come on suddenly, build up gradually over time, or are you not sure?
It came on gradually, over the years.
On an average day, how bad is the knee pain: mild, moderate, or severe — or you're not sure?
Severe, I'd say.
Are you taking any medicines regularly, have you started or changed any recently, or are you not taking any — or are you not sure — and if you know, please include the names and doses?
I've had cortisone injections in the knees.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
